TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Biak approaches
DATE 12 November 2028 · 2310 local
SIDE People's Liberation Army Navy
WINDOW 55 min, closes at 82
Z-18 helicopter. Photo: Z3144228 · CC0 · cropped
"Readiness is critical to an effective deterrence, not only in Air Force, but across all domains."
- Air Vice-Marshal Harvey Reynolds, Deputy Chief of Air Force, RAAF

BIAK APPROACHES, 2310. HAI YANG 7 is already on the final leg into the northern roads, about eleven miles from the holding point. She makes twelve knots: keep her moving while the escort clears the approaches. There is no need to sail the earlier open-water leg.

Contact GOLF is east of the route and closing across it. Expect her first torpedo attack at about minute ten if she is not stopped, with a second attack window at eighteen. The allocated Z-18F, DIPPER 23, is already ahead of the tanker; use it for the search rather than waiting for an optional purchased aircraft. A ship's flight and a Y-9 can add coverage if allocated.

A Meridian missile craft has also been identified north of the lane. Its launcher can reach the tanker and an attack is expected around minute fourteen. It is a declared hostile, separate from the submarine: screen both bearings. You may engage either shooter before it fires. GOLF's loss is remembered in the withdrawal mission.

If Sea Ear 31 completed Datum, its fifteen-minute position record remains available. It is a datum, not a fresh sonar contact. Classification earns a bonus; protecting the tanker and delivering her are the task.
The RAAF Poseidon records the run and is a protected non-belligerent with a neutral symbol. It is not providing the hostile craft's orders. Numfor's fishing boats and the coaster are protected too.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Fleet headquarters
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Deliver the fuel. GOLF and the declared hostile missile craft may be engaged; the Australian observer and civil traffic may not. Dipper 23 is allocated so the screen always has an airborne ASW search.
• Bring Hai Yang 7 into Biak's northern roads
• Keep Hai Yang 7 afloat
• Do not fire on the patrol aircraft
• Classify the submarine on the route
• Stop the missile craft on the northern flank
• Harm no fishing boat or coaster
Your screen, Dipper 23, Hai Yang 7 and the enclave field; a ship's flight and Y-9 if allocated. Hostile: GOLF and one missile craft. Protected: the Australian Poseidon and civil traffic.

The planned window is 55 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 27 minutes more; the operation is closed at 82 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
